cascaded_resize_pil_image: resize a PIL image using cascaded power-of-2 downscaling then BICUBIC upscaling to a target resolution
denormalize_tensor_to_0_1: denormalize a PyTorch tensor from the range [-1, 1] to [0, 1] using clamp
normalize_tensor_range: normalize a PyTorch tensor scaled in [0, 1] to a custom min and max range
create_diffusion_output_dataclass: create a DiffusionOutput dataclass instance with a prediction tensor and optional variance, mean, and log variance fields
review_diffusion_output_dataclass: review the DiffusionOutput dataclass fields including prediction, variance_value, mean, and log_variance
